entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Case :- Writ - C No. - 39886 of 2022
Petitioner :- Smt. Sheela Singh

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 7 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Bipin Bihari

Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioner to press the writ petition.

The order impugned dated 25.5.2022 which categorically records that the acquisition of the land in question, namely, Gata Nos. 54 and 55 (new Gata No. 23) had been acquired by acquisition notifications issued on 12.1.1962 under Sections 4 and 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 and the award had been passed on 07.08.1962.
The petitioner herein is purchaser of the land in question by virtue of the sale deed dated 07.09.2001.

entities.text: Sheela Singh vs State Of U.P. And 7 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 The prayer for grant of compensation and rehabilitate the petitioner under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013,
therefore, cannot be granted.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
